map.📚 深度解析：测量系统能力 Cgk: 📚 Deep Dive: Measurement system capability Cgk
map.Cgk = min(USL-mean, mean-LSL)/(3*sigma_m: Cgk = min(USL-mean, mean-LSL)/(3*sigma_measure). Example: with the mean off center by 0.002, Cgk is slightly lower than Cg.
map.Cgk=min(8−5.5, 5.5−2)/(3×0.25)=2.5/0.75=: Cgk = min(8-5.5, 5.5-2)/(3 x 0.25) = 2.5/0.75 = 3.333. The mean 5.5 sits exactly in the center; once it shifts, Cgk falls noticeably below Cg.
map.Cgk 额外考虑偏倚，更严格。: Cgk also accounts for bias and is therefore stricter.
map.测量能力指数 Cgk（本页代码口径）：Cgk=min(USL−x̄, x̄−LS: Measurement capability index Cgk (this page's code basis): Cgk = min(USL−x̄, x̄−LSL)÷(3×s) (the smaller distance from the mean to the upper/lower specification limit divided by 3 times the measurement standard deviation, 3 decimals). Validation: empty input in any of the four fields prompts and stops. Criteria: the code has no threshold branches; the common reading is Cgk ≥ 1.33 for a capable measurement system (covering both bias and spread), and below 1.33 you should find the bias source or reduce measurement variation.
